# One copy of a component instance a loop renders under an `if`, null-tested.
# bubbletea splices the instance into each copy and answers it from the view;
# the interpreter answers it from the tree it mounted. A target that builds the
# instance while the program runs has no copy key on it to find, and refuses
# the test where the instance is written rather than answering wrongly.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

! sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:14:21: a test reaches one copy of #b, an instance of badge this target builds while the program runs, which a compiled test cannot do yet'

! sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stderr 'a test reaches one copy of #b'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="hit {label} {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main node {
    var names = ["a", "b", "c"]
    var skip = "b"
    for var n = names {
        if n != skip {
            badge #b(label=n)
        }
    }
}

func testInstanceCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.b[0] != null)
    t.assert(c.b[1] == null)
    t.assert(c.b[2] != null)
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --

      "Desc": "InstanceCopy",
      "Passed": true
